in_hebrew.name: Astrahan
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Star of the heavens
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Astrahan הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'aster' meaning star, and 'hanos' meaning heavens or rule. The name Astrahan symbolizes divine guidance and celestial power.

in_greek.name: Astrahan
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Star of the heavens
in_greek.long_meaning: Astrahan είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'aster' meaning star, and 'hanos' meaning heavens or rule. The name Astrahan symbolizes divine guidance and celestial power.

in_latin.name: Astrahan
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Star of the heavens
in_latin.long_meaning: Astrahan est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'aster' meaning star, and 'hanos' meaning heavens or rule. The name Astrahan symbolizes divine guidance and celestial power.
